item.coloph: shin tu spros pa med pa'i de kho na nyid kyi man ngag ces bya ba/ slob dpon dpal ldan mthu stobs kyi mgon po thugs spros pa med pa'i dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin du/ sku'i spros pa dpag tu med pas gdug pa can tshar gcod cing / /bcom ldan 'das kyis dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bi rU pas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /bstan pa bsrung pa'i lha rnams kyi bu gcig pa ltar bskyangs pas rgyal po gzhan gyi phyir rgol bas glags lta bar mi nus pa'i ljongs chos kyis rgyal po'i sku mkhar nyi ma gzugs su/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paN+Di ta dngos grub brnyes pa dpal dar+pan A tsA r+ya dang/ glo bo lo tsA ba dge slong shes rab rin chen gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o
